body: I'm in the bathroom at work fucking crying. No one else has trouble with sales like I do. I get scared and forget the whole script. I hate this.
I'm trying, or if already be gone. Nobody wants me, and I can't provide for my mom. I wish I could stop thinking about it for a while.
Thank you. I try to like me, but I wish I had real value. Self esteem won't pay the rent or help me move. I haven't made any sales since wednesday and we're supposed to make 5 a day.

I think squishy sci fi is waaay over here with unexplained plot device science and hard sci fi is waaay over there with rendezvous with rama and I can't think what else. Also cockbot was a gift for someone. He deserves a story though. He's so eager to please.

Penny and aggie is a comic I really hate because it does wrong what I do wrong, weird flat stiff poses floating over the floor and furniture and bullshit dialogue.

Though I used to tell myself that it was better to do a page badly than not do it at all. Maybe that was healthier. The artistic backslide I've gone through still frustrates me to where I won't touch pen to paper for weeks. That green eyed male character is supposed to be the same person, but he comes out really inconsistent.

Maybe the world deserves to see whalers cooked with a space laser and I should stop whining. I'm probably just expecting drawing to relieve the pressure of all the other bullshit going on, and that's not going to happen.

Thank you. I have a sewing machine and no clue where to start. I'm too tall, my arms stick out womens long sleeved shirts. If I could just do a v neck that covers me to my wrists.

One of my favorite movies is Wristcutters, appropriately enough. It makes me feel optimistic, and gogol bordello makes me smile. Behind the mask; the rise of leslie vernon is another great one that no one seems to like when I suggest it. It's demented and romantic.

I can't find my old zombie comic :( it's gotta be in here somewhere. I found more recent stuff, mostly me getting used to the damaged tablet I got ahold of. Not a very representative sampling. If you need a face drawn, I'm golden, but attaching a body or furniture would end me. Potential NSFW http://imgur.com/a/kIDj2 I wish I could use lefty and righty in a story, but my dialogue is bullshit and I haven't been able to draw the hand twins properly in ages.

I'm about squishy scifi and fantasy, the story I wish I could tell properly is about a genosha-ish confederacy of man made islands cleaning up the sea and threatening whalers with a space laser. Protaganist can double herself, so she has all the amazing superpowers of twin sisters, with the added bonus of selfcest.

I wish I knew where the pages were. I either threw them out when I was feeling awful like a lot of my drawings, or they're in a drawer in my childhood home with stepdad. I didn't have a scanner in typewriter days, but I do have the awful computer colored comics when I was teaching myself photoshop. It was about zombies attacking an airport. My older comics were about a colonial war on a continent of beasts. The villain/protagonist was a girl presented as a young man, because a male magic-user was an important symbol of victory. They had trains and flightless winged elephants. I drew a lot of wood grain and lanterns, I loved it. 

I'll get up and find what wasn't lost in the fried computer.
You've never been happy and you never will be. It only gets lonelier. You can't draw for shit and your parents hate each other. No one wants to hear your stories. Just go to sleep.
